author: lactify
body: I admit I have combat logged at times but since I've never made an appeal lets see how this one goes. I deeply apologise for combat logging, this makes the gameplay unfair to the player that killed me. I know what it is like for someone to combat log on me. If it is possible, may I be unbanned. I was temp banned for combat logging as stated above. The ban durations lasts for a week and I know I shouldn't do it but I don't know why I still do. I deeply apologise. If you don't, this ban will remind me not to combat log ever again. I am not going against staff judgement, what needs to be done will be done.

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello, 

I am happy that you apologised for your actions. However, this was the third time, you should have stopped after your first infraction. You will not be appealed.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
